nodes.description: Public string state variable holding the token name 'Wrapped Ether'.
Public string state variable holding the token symbol 'WETH'.
Public uint8 state variable holding the token decimals (18).
Mapping(address => uint) tracking WETH balances; written in deposit, withdraw and transferFrom.
Nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) storing spending approvals; written in approve and transferFrom.
receive() external payable fallback that forwards value to deposit().
deposit() public payable; credits msg.value to msg.sender balance and emits Deposit.
withdraw(uint wad) public; debits caller balance then sends ether via msg.sender.transfer(wad).
totalSupply() public view returns the contract's ether balance.
approve(address guy, uint wad) public; sets allowance[msg.sender][guy] and emits Approval.
transfer(address dst, uint wad) public; delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender, dst, wad).
transferFrom(address src, address dst, uint wad) public; checks balance/allowance and moves balances between accounts.
Untrusted caller address used as balance owner, allowance owner and ether recipient.
State-modifying balance credit in deposit; susceptible to integer arithmetic issues.
Low-level ether transfer to an untrusted caller executed after state update; reentrancy-relevant external send.
Balance debit in withdraw relying on unchecked arithmetic (Solidity 0.6.12).
Allowance assignment driven by untrusted spender address and arbitrary amount.
Balance debit and credit in transferFrom using unchecked arithmetic.
Allowance decrement in transferFrom when spender differs from src and allowance is not max.
Amount parameter of withdraw(uint wad).
Spender address parameter of approve(address guy, uint wad).
Allowance amount parameter of approve(address guy, uint wad).
Recipient address parameter of transfer(address dst, uint wad).
Amount parameter of transfer(address dst, uint wad).
Source address parameter of transferFrom(address src, address dst, uint wad).
Destination address parameter of transferFrom(address src, address dst, uint wad).
Amount parameter of transferFrom(address src, address dst, uint wad).

edges.reason: receive() external payable forwards control to deposit(), making the payable fallback an entry point for value deposit.
deposit() executes balanceOf[msg.sender] += msg.value.
msg.sender is used as the balance key credited in deposit.
balanceOf mapping is read-modify-written by the deposit credit operation.
withdraw() executes balanceOf[msg.sender] -= wad after the balance require check.
withdraw() performs an external ether transfer to msg.sender via transfer().
msg.sender is the untrusted recipient of the ether send performed in withdraw.
msg.sender is the balance key decremented in withdraw.
balanceOf mapping is mutated by the withdraw debit operation.
approve() executes allowance[msg.sender][guy] = wad.
msg.sender determines the owner slot written during approve.
allowance mapping is written by the approve operation.
transfer() delegates control to transferFrom(msg.sender, dst, wad).
transferFrom() executes balanceOf[src] -= wad and balanceOf[dst] += wad.
transferFrom() decrements allowance[src][msg.sender] when spender is not src and allowance is not uint(-1).
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is decremented in transferFrom.
allowance mapping is read and mutated by the transferFrom allowance decrement.
balanceOf mapping is read and mutated by the transferFrom balance movements.
withdraw parameter wad is subtracted from balanceOf[msg.sender].
withdraw parameter wad determines the amount of ether transferred.
approve parameter guy is the spender key of the allowance assignment.
approve parameter wad is the value assigned to allowance.
transfer parameter dst is forwarded to transferFrom as the destination.
transfer parameter wad is forwarded to transferFrom as the amount.
transferFrom parameter src selects the debited balance and allowance owner.
transferFrom parameter dst selects the credited balance account.
transferFrom parameter wad drives the balance and allowance arithmetic.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter wad exists only to parameterize the withdraw entry point and its internal balance/transfer arithmetic; merge it into the core withdraw function node.
Parameter guy is only an argument of approve; merge it into the core approve function node.
Parameter wad is only an argument of approve; merge it into the core approve function node.
Parameter dst is only a forwarded argument of transfer; merge it into the core transfer function node.
Parameter wad is only a forwarded argument of transfer; merge it into the core transfer function node.
Parameter src is only used inside transferFrom for balance and allowance lookups; merge it into the core transferFrom function node.
Parameter dst is only used inside transferFrom as the credit target; merge it into the core transferFrom function node.
Parameter wad is only used inside transferFrom arithmetic; merge it into the core transferFrom function node.
